## JetBot AI Kit Assembly 

Components and screws  
Please check the components and screws  
![][image2]

##### 1\. Assemble motors. 

You will need silver colored metal nuts for M3  
![JetBot-Assembly-1.png][image3] [![JetBot-Assembly-2.png][image4]](https://www.waveshare.com/wiki/File:JetBot-Assembly-2.png)

##### 4\. Set standoffs on metal box for assembling JetBot expansion board. 

![Assembly-4.png][image5]

##### 3\. Mounting the Camera holder to the metal box, 

 fix the camera to the holder, and don't forget the Acrylic board.  
![JetBot-Assembly-6.png][image6]  
![][image7]

##### 4\. Set standoffs on metal box for assembling JetBot expansion board. 

![][image8]

##### 5\. Set standoffs on jetbot expansion board 

 for assembling jetson nano developer kit.  
![Assembly-5.png][image9]

##### 6\. Assemble Jetbot expansion board, and adjust the place of antennas. 

Mounting 18650 batteries to the batteries holder, you should check the direction of the batteries according to the stickers.  
![Assembly-8.png][image10]

##### 7\. Connect motors to the expansion board,  

and install two motors to the left and right.  
![Assembly-15.png][image11]

##### 8\. Turn out screws from Omni-direction wheels,  

then fix the wheels to the metal bottom board.  
![Assembly-14.png][image12]

##### 9\. Fix the metal board to the metal box. 

![Assembly-16.png][image13]

##### 10\. Assemble wheels and fix the Jetson Nano board. 

![Assembly-9.png][image14]

##### 11\. Connect the cooling fan. 

![Assembly-12.png][image15]

##### 12\. Connect the power adapter to the expansion board and turn the switch to On to power on the Kit. 

#### Note 

When you mount or replace the batteries for the first time, you need to connect the power adapter to the expansion board to charge the board for a while to make it work.
